method: Attribution covers the 50 correctness findings at f746f5a75ca7846d2bcc422142d9329ec0064f94. Reviewers followed blame through original diffs, parent versions, refactors and interacting features. The bugs have current-revision native verification; historical revisions were not executed or bisected. A source-traced introduction identifies the defective mechanism, not necessarily the earliest executable failing query. Names are Git authors, not assigned fix owners. Lineage, exposure and uncertain candidates are explicitly separate. Optimization-quality findings remain separate in optimization-quality.txt. No reproduction inputs are included.

The new-RBO parent before March lacks the common-type preparation maps. Its behavior for every mixed numeric family was not executed, so an earlier wrong-result route cannot be excluded.

items.description: Distributed joins partition inputs using the original key types, then normalize keys inside the join stage. Numerically equal keys with different hash representations can be sent to different partitions and never meet. Normalize keys before shuffle construction, and include normalized type/hash identity in distribution proofs. This also reproduces with the legacy optimizer and is not claimed as newly introduced.
